title: ovrdrvModeration
body:
# ⚡ ovrdrvModeration

> **Powerful moderation plugin for modern Minecraft servers (1.21+)**

---

## Commands

| Command | Description | Usage |
|--------|------------|------|
| `/ban` | Ban a player | `/ban <player> <time\|perm> <reason>` |
| `/unban` | Unban a player | `/unban <player> <reason>` |
| `/kick` | Kick a player | `/kick <player> <reason>` |
| `/mute` | Mute a player | `/mute <player> <time\|perm> <reason>` |
| `/unmute` | Unmute a player | `/unmute <player> <reason>` |
| `/warn` | Warn a player | `/warn <player> <time> <reason>` |
| `/unwarn` | Unwarn a player | `/unwarn <player> <id> <reason>` |
| `/warns` | View a player warns | `/warns <player>` |
| `/history` | View player history | `/history <player> [page]` |

---

## Permissions

### Main Permission
- `ovrdrvmoderation.*` — access to all commands

### Individual Permissions

| Permission | Description |
|-----------|------------|
| `ovrdrvmoderation.ban` | Access to `/ban` |
| `ovrdrvmoderation.unban` | Access to `/unban` |
| `ovrdrvmoderation.kick` | Access to `/kick` |
| `ovrdrvmoderation.mute` | Access to `/mute` |
| `ovrdrvmoderation.unmute` | Access to `/unmute` |
| `ovrdrvmoderation.history` | Access to `/history` |
| `ovrdrvmoderation.warn` | Access to `/warn` |
| `ovrdrvmoderation.unwarn` | Access to `/unwarn` |
| `ovrdrvmoderation.warns` | Access to `/warns` |
| `ovrdrvmoderation.notify` | Receive moderation notifications |

 By default, all permissions are granted to OP only

## Compatibility

- Minecraft **1.21+**
- Paper / Spigot / Purpur
- API Version: `1.21`
